name: design-system
description: Install, theme, and correctly call the components in @insolvia-ai/design-system, on web and on React Native

interface.shortDescription: Consume @insolvia-ai/design-system on web and React Native
interface.longDescription: Consumer-facing skills for @insolvia-ai/design-system and @insolvia-ai/tokens: installing them from GitHub Packages, wiring theme.css into a Tailwind v4 entrypoint, re-branding through the two override seams, choosing the right component, and debugging how one component name resolves to a web leaf under Vite and a native leaf under Metro.
